about_the_game:
Explore the waters of Lough Melvin, a scenic freshwater lake known for its depth, clarity, and unique mix of species. Cast from the shore or head out by boat, using float and spinning techniques to catch a variety of fish in real-time conditions.

Switch between first-person, third-person, and underwater camera views for a closer look at the action below the surface.

Demo features 10 species, including Northern pike, Atlantic salmon, Rainbow trout, Brown trout, Sea trout, Arctic char, Roach, Rudd, European perch, and European eel - each with their patterns, weight, and reactions to your approach.

Features

  • Float & Spinning
    Core techniques with their gear, strategies, and handling.

  • Rod Handling Modes
    Use Free Mode to stay mobile, then shift into Precision Mode for full control over your rod during the fight. Seamless transitions make fishing feel smooth and responsive.

  • Play as you like - Freeform Camera System
    Switch between first-person, third-person, and underwater lure view.

  • Day & Night cycle
    Fish during the day or night with dynamic time-flow as you roam around the lake.

  • Functional Sonars
    Use sonar to locate and follow fish beneath the surface in real time.

  • Boat
    The demo version contains one boat, which can be used for fishing. Boat customization is NOT available in the demo.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F / AMD Ryzen 5 1600 AF
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: Experience the calm waters of Lough Melvin in the Ultimate Fishing Simulator 3 Demo. Use float and spinning rods, navigate by boat, track fish with sonar, and enjoy multiple camera views while catching trout, salmon, pike, and more.
